==Description==
'''Summer Castle''' is an extremely long [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a beach surrounded by palm trees. It can be played in any of the survival modes. Every Triumph reward reduced by 0.5x (need change this tab)

==Design & Path==
'''Summer Castle''' takes places on the beach of an oversized island. The playable area of the map only contains two sand castles, one with leaves and one with a bucket on top, and a few small sand cliffs. Outside the playable area, multiple colorful buckets and shovels can be seen. There are also a few additional sand castles in the distance, one of which is destroyed. On one side of the map, a recliner can be seen with a cooler containing sodas on the side. Multiple palm trees can be found on one side of the non-playable area while the other is covered in water.

{{Map:Summer Castle}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Very Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The path in this path is quite long (being even longer than [[Polluted Wasteland II]]), meaning only towers with the highest of ranges can actually cover all of it.
**This makes high range towers overall pretty effective here. While mostly cliff towers like the [[Ranger]], some high range towers like the [[Necromancer]] or [[Turret]] can also be used.
*The center of the map is the ideal spot for towers, as it allows for good path coverage and is close to two cliff spots.
*As this map contains multiple paths placed close to each other, this allows for units which become stationary when attacking to attack enemies which while close physically, are pretty far on the path, allowing them to survive for longer.
**Examples of such units include the [[Crook Boss]] goons or [[Mercenary Base]] mercenaries.

==Trivia==
*'''Summer Castle''' is the second longest map that is currently in the game, with the third longest map with being [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and the first longest map with being [[Severing Connection]].
